subject: Security attestation renewal — operational runbook, evidence surge, and capacity uplift
messages:
From: Sophie Park <sophie@hearthbank.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Daniel Rios <daniel.rios@hearthbank.com>, procurement@hearthbank.com
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & SOC 2 re-attestation — ask and timing

Hi Vivek / Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick discussion earlier. As HearthBank moves toward contract renewal (term end 2027-07-31) we need to align on two parallel streams: SOC 2 re-attestation for the new term and a modest capacity uplift for our fraud-detection batch jobs.

High level asks from our side:
- Updated evidence index for systemic controls (logs, retention, backups) — full inventory by 2027-05-22
- Confirmation of log retention windows (we currently need 18 months, asking if you can support 24 months for a new product line)
- A short operational runbook or checklist for our security team to map artifacts to controls (SOC 2 CC’s)
- Quote for a 30% seat/throughput bump for Dedicated for a 6-month trial period, plus any renewal credit options

Can Redwood provide a runbook draft and an evidence upload timeline that lines up with our internal audit window (audit kickoff 2027-06-15)? Also please call out any temporary costs (burst capacity, staging buckets) and whether Redwood can provide a one-time credit for audit-related transfers.

Thanks,
Sophie
Director, Security & Compliance
HearthBank

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Park <sophie@hearthbank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & SOC 2 re-attestation — ask and timing

Sophie — thanks for the clear list. We can support this timeline; below is an initial operational runbook outline and the team owners. I’ll put firm delivery dates in the next update.

Quick answers:
- Evidence index: we will produce a numbered index (spreadsheet + summary PDF) by 2027-05-20. This will include mapping to SOC 2 CCs and sample artifacts.
- Retention: Redwood hosted API retains audit logs for 18 months by default. We can extend to 24 months under a term amendment; I’ll include cost delta.
- Runbook: Draft attached (operational-runbook-draft.pdf) — it’s a concise checklist covering artifact locations, sampling guidance, and owner contacts.
- Capacity uplift: Ben will run capacity numbers and present a 6-month pilot offer plus renewal credit options.

Owners:
- Evidence index & mapping: Kimberly Park (kimberly_park) — upload coordination to your staging bucket.
- Log retention amendment & pricing delta: Laura Bennett (laura_bennett) — legal/finance handshake for amendment language.
- Dedicated uplift pricing & pilot terms: Ben Carter (ben_carter) — seats/throughput.
- Evidence ingestion & automation: Priyom Das (priyom_das) — will share upload instructions and CSV mapping.

Next steps from Redwood this week:
1) Deliver evidence index v1 (spreadsheet) — 2027-05-20
2) Share runbook draft (attached) and a short video walkthrough — 2027-05-18
3) Capacity uplift proposal (numbers + pilot PO/credit options) — 2027-05-21

If any of these dates are tight for your side, flag and we’ll re-prioritize.

Best,
Vivek
VP, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

--
Redwood Inference | High-performance LLM inference — redwood.ai
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Sophie Park <sophie@hearthbank.com>, Daniel Rios <daniel.rios@hearthbank.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & SOC 2 re-attestation — ask and timing

Dropping initial numbers for the Dedicated uplift. Sophie / Daniel — this is an early draft to align expectations before we finalize pricing and pilot terms.

Scenario A (throughput-based): 30% throughput bump via an additional reserved pool for 6 months
- Estimated incremental cost (6 months): $46,200
- Pilot structure: 1 month pro-rated trial, then 5 months reserved at discounted rate
- One-time staging transfer: estimated 1.2 TB (audit evidence movement) — we can waive ingress charges for the transfer if we accept a renewal commitment of 12+ months at the end of the pilot.

Scenario B (seat-based): add 12 seats (concurrency units) to current plan for 6 months
- Estimated incremental cost (6 months): $39,600
- Pilot: immediate enablement, roll-back at end of 6 months if not used

Runbook/evidence flow notes: Priyom will provide a CSV mapping (log-retention-mapping.csv) and a short script to automate uploads to your staging bucket. Kimberly and I will coordinate the sample artifact list — we’ll keep the index focused to 40-60 representative items for the audit.

I’ll fold final numbers into the renewal amendment once legal confirms the retention change language.

Ben
Principal Product Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: SOC2_evidence_index_v3.xlsx
From: Daniel Rios <daniel.rios@hearthbank.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Sophie Park <sophie@hearthbank.com>, procurement@hearthbank.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:49:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & SOC 2 re-attestation — ask and timing

Thanks — this looks good and helpful. A couple of follow-ups from procurement side:
1) Can you confirm the retention amendment language (we need explicit clause for 24 months retention and the ability to export logs on demand)?
2) Will the waived ingress require us to sign the 12-month renewal commitment immediately or can that be an umbrella option post-pilot?
3) We need a DocuSign-friendly redline of the renewal amendment by 2027-05-24 to get the legal review started.

Operational note: we’d like the runbook to include an example mapping for one control (CC6.1 — System Logging) so our auditors can see the artifact path. Can Kimberly drop that example into the index?

Best,
Daniel
Head of Procurement, HearthBank

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Park <sophie@hearthbank.com>, Daniel Rios <daniel.rios@hearthbank.com>, procurement@hearthbank.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & SOC 2 re-attestation — ask and timing

Team — quick status update and asks so we stay on the same page before legal churn.

Status:
- Evidence index v3 (SOC2_evidence_index_v3.xlsx) attached to this thread and shared in Drive. Includes a worked example mapping to CC6.1 (system logging).
- Runbook draft (operational-runbook-draft.pdf) uploaded — Priyom recorded a 12-minute walkthrough (link above).
- Pricing: Ben’s scenario numbers are the working proposals. Laura is drafting the retention amendment language; we will produce a redline (DocuSign-ready) by 2027-05-24.

Two asks for HearthBank:
1) Please confirm whether HearthBank will accept the ingress waiver as an option to be exercised at the end of the pilot in exchange for a 12-month renewal commitment. If yes, state: "Ingress waiver to be exercisable upon signing 12-month renewal after pilot".
2) For the evidence upload, please provision a secure S3 staging bucket and share write credentials to priya_upload@redwood.ai by 2027-05-19 EOD (we can accept alternate flows if you have an internal transfer process).

If those two items are green, we’ll circulate the DocuSign redline on Monday (2027-05-24) and Ben will finalize the pilot PO.

Thanks all — Vivek
VP, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
